The '''2023 Copa Libertadores final''' was the final match which decided the winner of the [[2023 Copa Libertadores]]. This was the 64th edition of the [[Copa Libertadores]], the top-tier South American continental club [[Association football|football]] tournament organized by [[CONMEBOL]]. The match was played between Argentine team [[Boca Juniors]] and Brazilian side [[Fluminense FC|Fluminense]] on 4 November 2023 at the [[Maracanã Stadium|Maracanã]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]], Brazil.<ref>{{Cite web |title=La Final de la CONMEBOL Libertadores 2023 se jugará en el Maracaná |url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/la-final-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-2023-se-jugara-en-el-maracana |access-date=2023-10-05 |website=conmebollibertadores.com}}</ref>

Fluminense won their first ever [[Copa Libertadores]] by defeating Boca Juniors 2–1 after [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://conmebollibertadores.com/cards/NewsReaderWeb/fluminense-campeon-de-la-conmebol-libertadores |title=¡Fluminense campeón de la CONMEBOL Libertadores! |trans-title=Fluminense champion of the CONMEBOL Libertadores! |publisher=CONMEBOL Libertadores |language=es |date=4 November 2023 |access-date=4 November 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2023/nov/04/boca-juniors-fluminense-copa-libertadores-final-match-report|title=Fluminense beat Boca Juniors in extra time to win first Copa Libertadores title|date=4 November 2023|work=Guardian|accessdate=6 November 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/67324231|title=Boca Juniors 1 Fluminense 2|date=4 November 2023|work=BBC Sport|accessdate=6 November 2023}}</ref>

As winners, Fluminense qualified for the [[2023 FIFA Club World Cup|2023]] and [[2025 FIFA Club World Cup]]s and earned the right to play against the [[2023 Copa Sudamericana]] winners [[L.D.U. Quito|LDU]] in the [[2024 Recopa Sudamericana]] (which Fluminense would later go on to win as well). They also automatically qualified for the [[2024 Copa Libertadores]] group stage.
